# PayRam

> Private, self-hosted crypto payment gateway: payment links, hosted checkout
> (USDC/BTC/ETH and more), on-chain deposit detection, sweeps to a cold wallet
> you control. No account lock, no fund freeze, customer data never shared,
> no deposit keys on the server - because it runs on your own server.
> This host also serves the PayRam MCP server.

Agents: start at /SKILL.md. On the MCP, call payram_setup_plan to install,
payram_doctor to check a server, payram_runbook for admin tasks and
payram_ops_playbook for day-to-day operations. The hosted MCP never holds
merchant credentials: ops recipes run with your own credentials.

## Start here

- [Agent front door (SKILL.md)](https://mcp.payram.com/SKILL.md): what PayRam is, the four start-here tools, install command, human hand-offs, credentials
- [MCP endpoint](https://mcp.payram.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP (POST), no auth headers, no SSE; setup plans, server checks, runbooks, ops recipes, codegen
- [Skills index](https://mcp.payram.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): 19 specialized skills (setup, payments, webhooks, payouts, testing, ...)

## Setup

- Install on the server, in an interactive terminal once: `bash <(curl -fsSL https://payram.com/setup_payram_agents.sh) --testnet` (or `--mainnet`; the default is mainnet). Never pipe it into bash.
- [Headless agent setup guide](https://github.com/PayRam/payram-scripts/blob/main/docs/PAYRAM_HEADLESS_AGENT.md): the canonical flow, env vars, merchant/operator modes, troubleshooting
- [Setup script](https://payram.com/setup_payram_agents.sh): one-step install -> payment link -> API key
